name: Division of Biology and Biomedical Sciences (DBBS) PhD

deadlines.label: Application and letters deadline
deadlines.note: The page says the application is open through November 15 at 11:59 PM EST. Letters must arrive by then too; applications missing letters are not reviewed.

timeline.interviews: Most applicants hear about interview decisions by the end of December.
timeline.decisions: Interviewed applicants are notified no later than mid-March.

english.note: Needed if your first language isn't English. Scores must be under two years old at the deadline, sent officially; superscores such as TOEFL MyBest are not accepted. Some exemptions apply.

applicationFee.note: Waivers exist for certain programs and groups; international applicants living outside the US are not eligible.

documents: Two DBBS essays (up to 2 single-spaced pages each)

funding.note: All accepted applicants receive the same funding and financial support.

international.note: No set number of international admits; international students have historically been about 38% of the entering class.
